description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for Git operations, specifically testing 'git add -u' and 'git commit -a'. It sets up repositories, modifies files, and verifies the correct behavior of Git commands in various scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A test framework function to specify a test case that must succeed.

methods.description: Checks for required prerequisites for tests, e.g., support for symlinks.

methods.description: Advances the internal clock or timestamp used in tests.

methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
